decisionsTitle: The members' race number goes to every registration that ticked «Sunt membru» — no account, no second question (amending §664, §681, §662)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-17**, four days before Saturday's race, printing its bibs: «când o să faci să apară acel marker pentru membrii BVR?» — «că momentan nu se deosebesc cu nimic». Asked who should get the members' race number, he chose: **everyone who ticked at registration that they are a member of the club — no account, no second tick; a wrong tick is corrected by the Administrator with «Modifică datele»**.

**What was there.** Since §664 a registration printed with the members' race number — the members' design and, when the design ticks it, the member mark (§681, §695, §750, §759) — only when three facts met: the event's bib design offered it («Membrii primesc un număr cu design propriu»), the person had ticked «Vreau numărul de membru» under «Sunt membru al grupului {club}», and the registration's canonical address was a live account's on «Echipa» (§662's verified rule). Most of the club's members have no account, and most registered before the question existed: no bib differed. The bibs page said so in a line («Au cerut numărul de membru, dar adresa lor nu e a unui cont de membru…») linking to a filtered list, the export said `asked`, and the registration's page «cerut, neverificat».

### The decision

**1. One rule, in one place.** A registration prints with the members' race number when the event's bib design offers it AND its `club_member_declared` is true AND it is not marked «Elită» — an elite bib never wears the members' design (§897, unchanged). Nothing else: no account on «Echipa», no «Vreau numărul de membru», not `kind` (a test registration answers like a real one, and the sheet's own scope keeps it off the paper, §30), not the state (what prints is the sheet's scope, `bibs.ts#bibScopeWhere`: confirmed, real, numbered). The rule is two twins side by side: the SQL `registrations/member-bib.ts#PRINTS_MEMBER_BIB` — with the switch's own reading `OFFERS_MEMBER_BIB`, moved there from `events/repository.ts` and read nowhere else in SQL — and the TypeScript `registrations/domain/member-bib.ts#printsMemberBib`. Every place that decided it reads one of them: the sheet's rows and its members' part first (§681, `listBibs`); the bibs page's counts, its two part downloads and its grid (from `listBibs`); the bib's picture — the desk's, the grid's, the registration's (`printsMemberBib` over its one row); the registrations list's row and the registration's page (`memberBib`, selected in their queries); and the export's «Member bib», `yes` or empty from the row. The account lookup is gone from all of them. The SQL is built from two nested pieces so its columns print qualified even in a one-table select (`listBibs` joins nothing now), and it reads the event's switch through its own `EXISTS`, so it is the same text in every query; it reads no other module's export while it is defined, so a test that stands in for a repository never finds it half-made.

Why one place: the rule had grown into six readings — the sheet's SQL, the unverified count's, the list filter's, the picture's TypeScript, the registration page's `memberBibOf`, the export's `memberBibCell` — each with its own copy of the three facts, and one drifting is how a bib shows one design on the grid and prints another. A test reads every caller from disk (`member-bib-callers.test.ts`); another runs the two twins over every combination of the three facts in a joined select, a one-table select and a `WHERE` (`member-bib-declared.test.ts`).

**2. The question goes.** «Vreau numărul de membru» is asked no more: not on the public form (nor in an invited member's prefill), not on the staff entry, not in «Modifică datele» (`answers.ts#EDITABLE_ANSWERS` drops it, so a correction naming it is refused by name, as any key outside the allowlist). A posted box is never read: the form's reading and the staff action no longer read it, and the schemas no longer name it, so Zod drops it. The column `registrations.member_bib_wanted` stays in the table untouched — no migration, expand/contract, a later change may drop it: nothing reads it, every row the form writes stores false (a restart's too, since a restart spreads the form's answers over the old row) and older rows keep what they said. An old correction in the trail keeps its words (`answers.ts#RETIRED_ANSWERS`; the label `Admin.registrations.answers.fields.memberBibWanted` stays for it). Clearing the member tick writes no second audit row for the wish any more. The member tick itself, its words and its «?» are unchanged.

With the question go the state and everything that showed it: the bibs page's «asked but not verified» line and its link, the list's `memberBib=asked` filter (a bookmarked address now shows everyone), the export's `asked`, the registration page's «Număr de membru: cerut, neverificat». `countUnverifiedMemberBibs`, `memberBibKept`, `memberBibOf` and `memberBibTickedAtFirst` are deleted; the public event read and the staff entry's event list no longer carry `offersMemberBib`.

**3. The designer says it.** The switch's help (`Admin.editor.bibDesign.member.enabledHelp`): «Numărul membrilor îl primește fiecare înscriere care a bifat „Sunt membru al grupului {club}”, în afară de elite. O bifă greșită se corectează cu «Modifică datele». Numărul rămâne în aceeași ordine.» / “Every registration that ticked “I am a member of the {club} group” gets the members' number, except elites. Correct a wrong tick with «Change the answers». The number keeps its order.” The guide's printing step says the same. The member tick's help in «Modifică datele» adds «Bifa decide și numărul membrilor, unde evenimentul îl oferă.», and the four sentences that told an Administrator that setting or clearing the tick changes «nimic altceva» — the list's «⋮» set and clear, the members' sweep's question and its banner — now say that the place and the number stay and, where the event offers the members' number, which design prints. SETUP §39 gains the switch's row; `AGENTS.md` §12.6 and `BUSINESS.md` say the tick decides this one look.

**4. Nothing else moves:** the number, its series and the order of confirmation (§173), a place, the elite sheet (§895, §963), the members' design itself (§664, §695, §750, §759) and its pages printed first (§681). A test registration behaves like a real one in the queue; `kind` is in no new condition, and neither the allocator nor the capacity formula reads the tick (§48, `AGENTS.md` §12.6).

### Privacy

The members' design shows on the bib — worn in public on race day — the membership the person declared on the form; until now the person also had to ask for it, and to hold an account. Showing it from the tick alone is the owner's choice. The tick is the person's own answer about themselves (BR-REQ-031-06, §48): never checked against a roster, corrected by an Administrator when wrong. The privacy notice's template (`legal-documents/templates/privacy-notice.ts`) lists the tick among the optional answers — «neverificate, fără efect asupra locului» — and names no members' bib, before this change or after; no sentence of the notice, the terms or the declaration promised the members' bib only on request, so no legal text changes (an agent never edits one). Whether the notice should name the members' design on the bib is the club's question for its lawyer.

### Not in this change, on purpose

- **A manual «Membru BVR pe BIB» toggle** beside the tick: the tick is the rule, and a second flag could disagree with it.
- **Checking the tick against a roster or the accounts on «Echipa»**: the owner chose the tick alone. §662's «Membru (verificat)» chip on the list is unchanged and decides nothing of the bib.
- **Dropping `member_bib_wanted`**: a contract migration for a later release, now that nothing reads it.
- **Reworking the members' sweep «Bife de membru fără cont de membru» (§645)**: it still lists the ticks with no account — now exactly the members' bibs without one — and its question and banner say what clearing them does to the bib.

Tests: unit `registrations/member-bib-callers.test.ts` (the rule's SQL holds the three facts and no wish, account, kind or state; it is defined once; every caller reads it; nothing on a bib's path imports the accounts; the wish's column is read nowhere and written false once; no catalogue asks the question), `registrations/member-bib-form.test.ts` (the public form, in Română and in English, with no «Vreau numărul de membru» at an event offering the members' bib; a posted box dropped by the form's reading and by both schemas), `registrations/member-bib.test.ts` (the truth table of `printsMemberBib`, `yes` or empty, an invited member's prefill), `registrations/missing-answers.test.ts`, `registrations/form-errors.test.ts`, `notifications/no-hardcoded-values.test.ts`; integration `registrations/member-bib-declared.test.ts` (the twins agree over every combination in three query shapes; neither `kind` nor the state is read; the sheet flags the tick with no account and prints the members' pages first; an account without the tick prints the ordinary bib; the switch off; an elite bib never the members'; a cancelled and a test registration off the paper and without a picture; the picture as the sheet prints it; the export's CSV and workbook; the list's and the registration page's `memberBib`; a restart writing the wish false), `registrations/member-bib-declared-screens.test.ts` (the bibs page's count, part downloads and grid order with no account, nothing with the switch off, no «asked» line; «Număr de membru» on the registration's page by the rule; «Modifică datele» and the staff entry without the box, in Română and in English); and `member-bib.test.ts`, `member-bib-preview.test.ts`, `member-bibs-first.test.ts`, `elite-mark.test.ts` and `member-tick-screens.test.ts` brought to the new rule where it changed, each case saying so. Amends §664 (who wears the members' bib; the wish, the unverified line and its filter retired), §681 (the members' pile is the tick's), §662 (the verified reading no longer decides a print) and §645 (one answer fewer).
changelogLine: - **The members' race number goes to everyone who ticked «Sunt membru»** — no account on «Echipa» and no second question: at a race whose bib design offers it, every registration with the member tick prints in the members' design (never an elite one), the members' pages first; «Vreau numărul de membru» is gone from every form, and a wrong tick is corrected with «Modifică datele». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 50, 52 and 108's last clause. Given an event whose bib design has «Membrii primesc un număr cu design propriu» on, when the sheet and its members' part, the bibs page's counts, the bib's picture, the registration's page or the export decide which bib a registration prints, then they read one rule — the design offers it, the registration's `club_member_declared` is true, and it is not marked «Elită» — with or without a member account on «Echipa» and whatever «Vreau numărul de membru» once said; a row without the tick, every row while the switch is off and an elite row print the ordinary or the elite bib, a cancelled or a test registration stays off the sheet and has no picture, the export's «Member bib» reads `yes` or empty, and neither the bibs page's «asked but not verified» line nor the list's filter for it exists any more (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 20 and 21. «Vreau numărul de membru» is asked no more: the public form, an invited member's prefill, the staff entry and «Modifică datele» draw no such box, a posted one is never read, every row the form writes — a restart's too — stores false in the kept `member_bib_wanted` column, a correction naming it is refused by name, and clearing the member tick writes no audit row for it (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose bib design offers the members' race number, then the member tick is what prints it — the same number in the same order, never a place, a price or a queue position, and no account consulted; an Administrator corrects a wrong tick with «Modifică datele», whose help for the tick says so (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 41's words only: «the club's members list» it reads is §662's live accounts on «Echipa» — no longer the members' race numbers' test, which reads the member tick since §NNN; the club cell's rule is unchanged (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the members' race number for everyone who ticked «Sunt membru», no account and no second question
